name: Choose a grade and complete a workbook lesson
description: Verifies the primary learner flow from grade selection through answering a lesson question and saving progress.
steps: Select Mathematics and open Counting Objects
Select the correct answer for the first question
Check the answer and continue through the lesson
expected: The learner receives feedback, can complete the lesson, and the Progress view reflects the lesson activity.

name: Use revision mode on mobile
description: Verifies revision is reachable and usable on a phone-sized viewport.
expected: The revision page and lesson open without horizontal layout problems, and the learner can select an answer.

name: View learner progress
description: Verifies the progress dashboard loads and displays learner progress from the application state.
expected: The learner name remains available and the progress dashboard displays grade and subject progress.

name: Open adult learning overview
description: Verifies the adult view shows learning progress by grade and a revision recommendation based on actual activity.
steps: Review the Grade 1 to Grade 3 rows
expected: The overview displays Mathematics and English progress for each grade and shows an appropriate next-step message.

name: Prevent submitting an unanswered question
description: Verifies the learner cannot submit a question before selecting an answer.
expected: The Check answer button remains disabled until an option is selected.
